outcome: time interval between dinoprostone insertion to active phase of labour
duration of active phase of labour
time interval between dinoprostone insertion and complete cervical dilatation
cohort: Pregnant women undergoing labor induction with a dinoprostone vaginal insert were allocated into a douching group or a control group.
finding: Vaginal douching with normal saline transiently increases vaginal pH but does not improve the chances of vaginal delivery; instead, intrinsic vaginal pH is a better decisive factor for successful vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Vaginal douching with normal saline did not significantly affect the mode of delivery, while intrinsic vaginal pH was found to be a better predictor of successful vaginal delivery.
